description: SPEAK-EVAL-004. Source governance for speaking evaluation items. An item may only contribute to a gating metric if this manifest says it may.

quarantine.purpose: Items that exist but must not influence any published number. Nothing here can gate, by construction.

items.notes: Pipeline fixture, not a scoring item. Two Windows SAPI voices reading a scripted examiner/candidate exchange, so the turn boundaries are exact and diarization quality can be measured rather than eyeballed. Quarantined permanently: synthesised speech has no disfluency and unnaturally clean turn boundaries, so metrics measured on it are an upper bound on real performance, and it carries no human band at all.

permission.basis: Generated by this project from Windows SAPI voices reading a script written for the purpose. No third-party recording, performer or publisher rights are involved, which is why it can be committed where a real IELTS recording could not.

items.notes: Official IELTS speaking sample, Vietnam, examiner-assigned overall band 5.0. Transcript with examiner commentary; NO audio is published, and no per-criterion bands are given -- the examiner comments on all four criteria in prose but assigns one number. Usable for the scorer-only lane against the overall band; cannot exercise the audio path.

permission.basis: Publicly published by the IELTS Partners as scoring guidance. The page carries a general copyright notice and states no reuse permission either way. Nobody has reviewed the terms, so this stays `pending` -- which under rule 1 means it cannot gate. Recording it as `granted` would be deciding a rights question by assumption, which is the failure this field exists to prevent.

items.notes: IELTS Speaking Test- Band 6.5. Full two-speaker exam. Band claimed in the video title and asserted by the channel owner, a certified examiner. Per the source hierarchy a title is metadata to investigate, not a label -- the band below records the examiner's stated assessment, and no per-criterion scores are published. Second reviewer still required before gating.

permission.basis: The channel owner replied by email granting use of the playlist recordings for this project's evaluation. Keep that email as the permission evidence. Grant covers download and internal evaluation; it does NOT cover redistribution, which is why the audio is marked restricted and is never committed.
